claim_boundaries.aabb_envelopes_only: Inputs remain world.get_bbox-derived axis-aligned boxes and projected min/max envelopes, not OBBs, meshes, silhouettes, masks or image pixels.
claim_boundaries.descriptive_extrema_only: Component extrema are not tolerances, quality scores, camera comparisons, fixture decisions, population estimates or evidence of physical cause.
claim_boundaries.frozen_correspondence_expansion_only: This report decomposes a pinned prior diagnostic and adds no independent observation, scene, mapping, label, model request or robot episode.
claim_boundaries.no_measurement_or_endpoint_inference: No crop/time mapping, labelability, annotation, r0/rhat/r endpoint, generated/executed correspondence or A1-A9 result is authenticated.
claim_boundaries.science_and_dispatch: No scientific stage, qualification state, dispatch authority or confirmation status changes from this retained-only decomposition.
claim_boundaries.selection_confounding: All three mapping pairs remain availability-selected. D01/D02 have disjoint command membership and P00 has unequal command membership.

decomposition_semantics.constructed_reference: The frozen upstream reference reflects each retained original center from (x,y,z) to (x,-y,z) and translates its retained AABB without changing the original extents. It is constructed geometry, not an intended fixture pose, an acceptance specification, an observed image or an independent measure.
decomposition_semantics.extrema: Minimum, maximum and largest-absolute records are deterministic descriptive summaries with full source provenance. They do not order scientific merit, select a camera or establish an acceptance predicate.
decomposition_semantics.mixed_residual_sources: Residual components can mix center settling, orientation settling, AABB shape changes and numeric capture. This decomposition assigns no component to any physical cause.
decomposition_semantics.signed_components: World signs follow robot-base x/y/z. Projected image signs follow stored u/v coordinates; width and height are upper-minus-lower envelope extents. Camera-z signs follow stored lower/upper interval edges. Absolute values are abs(signed value) with no epsilon, clipping or normalization.
decomposition_semantics.source: Every value is a deterministic expansion of the exact frozen Turn2847 actual-minus-constructed correspondence residual vectors. No new source record, raw camera byte, cluster artifact or current-state field is read.

finding: The nine frozen world rows expand to 135 signed/absolute axis components, and the 36 frozen camera-object rows expand to 360 signed/absolute projected/depth components. The report preserves exact row provenance and descriptive extrema globally, by object and by camera. It introduces no threshold, fitting, measurement endpoint or scientific comparison.
